meta.title: Team building and company outings in Antwerp
meta.description: Team challenges, private walks and outings for companies and groups in Antwerp, self-guided on your own phones or with a guide. Ask for a quote.

title: Team building in the streets of Antwerp
intro: Discover Antwerp together: a team challenge, a private walk or a full company outing. Self-guided on your own phones, or with a guide. Every programme is made to measure.

offers.team-building: Teams solve tasks and riddles on location across the old city, on their own phones, with a live leaderboard.
offers.hidden-pubs-team-challenge: Our café game for teams: tasks, cards and stories in Antwerp's cafés. For adults (18+); everyone chooses their own drink, alcohol-free counts just the same.
offers.alcohol-free-city-challenge: The team challenge without cafés: the same teamwork and city tasks, completely alcohol-free.
offers.private-walk: One of our walks for your group alone, on a date that suits you.
offers.company-outing: A half or full day out in Antwerp, combining a walk or challenge with your own programme.
offers.international-group: The walks and games are available in eight languages, so mixed teams can play together.

pricesIntro: For the whole group. Your quote is made to measure.
notIncluded: Drinks, catering and extra services are priced separately.

how.step1: Send us your request with the date, group size and what you have in mind.
how.step2: We contact you and send a proposal made to measure.
how.step3: Once you agree, we prepare everything for your day in Antwerp.

form.title: Ask for a quote
form.privacy: We only use these details to answer your request. Requests are deleted after two years.
form.thanks: Thank you! We've received your request and will contact you soon. You'll also get a confirmation by email.
